title: Manifold-Constrained Initial Noise Optimization for Efficient Generative Model Alignment
title_zh: 面向高效生成模型对齐的流形约束初始噪声优化

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in distillation and flow-map models have enabled deterministic one- or few-step generation for high-quality data, facilitating a new branch of reward alignment approaches that directly optimize the initial noise from a Gaussian distribution. However, most existing initial-noise optimization methods rely on first-order gradient information, which is either inapplicable or suffers from instability and inefficiency in black-box reward scenarios. Here, we introduce ZeNOVA ( Ze roth-order N oise O ptimization with V alue A nnealing), a stable and efficient initial noise alignment method in a gradient-free manner. Specifically, we address existing algorithms’ major challenge in black-box scenarios through annealed soft-value guidance, manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics, and Metropolis-Hastings jumping. Extensive experiments on image and video generative models show that ZeNOVA outperforms all evaluated zeroth-order baselines by optimizing the initial noise toward higher rewards substantially more stably while exploiting the geometry of the Gaussian prior, demonstrating its practical applicability to various black-box reward alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 蒸馏与流映射模型的最新进展使得高质量数据的确定性一步或少步生成成为可能，并催生了一类直接优化高斯分布初始噪声的奖励对齐新方法。 然而，大多数现有的初始噪声优化方法依赖于一阶梯度信息，这在黑盒奖励场景中要么不可用，要么存在不稳定和低效的问题。 在此，我们提出 ZeNOVA（Ze roth-order N oise O ptimization with V alue A nnealing，基于价值退火的零阶噪声优化），这是一种以无梯度方式进行的稳定且高效的初始噪声对齐方法。 具体而言，我们通过退火软价值引导、流形约束的超球面朗之万动力学以及 Metropolis-Hastings 跳跃，解决了现有算法在黑盒场景中的主要难题。 在图像与视频生成模型上的大量实验表明，ZeNOVA 在利用高斯先验几何结构的同时，能够更稳定地将初始噪声优化至更高奖励，性能优于所有被评估的零阶基线方法，展示了其在各类黑盒奖励对齐中的实际适用性。

paragraphs.en: Reward alignment of a pre-trained generative model aims to align its output distribution to admit higher external reward while minimizing its deviation from the original prior. A wide range of fine-tuning based approaches are presented grounded on several theoretical support, including entropy-regularized reinforcement learning ( Black et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; He et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026a ) , GFlowNets ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2025b ) , and stochastic optimal control ( Domingo-Enrich et al., 2025 ) . Inference-time methods employing various techniques such as diffusion posterior sampling ( Chung et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023a ) and path integral control ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) have also been proposed to implement the same effect without additional training.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练生成模型的奖励对齐旨在使其输出分布对齐以获得更高的外部奖励，同时最小化其与原始先验的偏差。 基于若干理论支持的多种微调方法已被提出，包括熵正则化强化学习（ Black et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; He et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026a ）、GFlowNets（ Zhang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2025b ）以及随机最优控制（ Domingo-Enrich et al., 2025 ）。 采用扩散后验采样（ Chung et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023a ）和路径积分控制（ Huang et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2025 ）等多种技术的推理时方法也被提出，无需额外训练即可实现相同效果。

paragraphs.en: However, these works have to assume stochastic sampling trajectories involving many intermediate steps for their methods to analytically admit the reward-tilted distribution and thereby satisfy both the prior and high reward. Consequently, naively extending the results of these works to deterministic generative models is either limited or does not guarantee its behavior as theoretically designed. Moreover, recent advances in generative modeling have led to the development of few-step or one-step models including distilled models ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Sauer et al., 2024 ) and flow-map models ( Song et al., 2023b ; Geng et al., 2025 ) , which reduces the effect of control in between intermediate sampling process.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些工作必须假设随机采样轨迹包含许多中间步骤，其方法才能在解析上得到奖励偏置分布，从而同时满足先验和高奖励。 因此，将这些工作的结果直接扩展到确定性生成模型，要么效果有限，要么无法保证其行为符合理论设计。 此外，生成建模的最新进展催生了少步或单步模型的发展，包括蒸馏模型（Yin et al., 2024b；Yin et al., 2024a；Sauer et al., 2024）和流映射模型（Song et al., 2023b；Geng et al., 2025），这削弱了在中间采样过程中进行控制的效果。

paragraphs.en: These recent advances facilitate a separate approach of initial-noise optimization as a practical route to inference-time reward alignment; a pretrained deterministic generator can produce different outputs by changing its Gaussian input, without updating its parameters ( Eyring et al., 2024 ; Min et al., 2026 ; Yoon et al., 2026 ) . Most existing approaches, however, obtain their optimization directions by differentiating through both the generator and the reward computation. This requirement limits their use when the reward is non-differentiable or available only through black-box evaluations, and can impose substantial computational overhead even when gradients are accessible. Estimating directions from reward queries offers a gradient-free alternative, but useful alignment also requires these estimates to support stable and efficient optimization in the high-dimensional noise space. In particular, seeking higher rewards should account for the Gaussian noise input geometry on which the generator was trained, which still remains challenging with optimizations in gradient-free manner.
paragraphs.zh: 这些最新进展使得初始噪声优化作为一种实用的推理时奖励对齐途径成为可能：预训练的确定性生成器可以通过改变其高斯输入来产生不同的输出，而无需更新其参数（Eyring et al., 2024；Min et al., 2026；Yoon et al., 2026）。 然而，大多数现有方法通过同时对生成器和奖励计算进行微分来获得优化方向。 这一要求限制了它们在奖励不可微或只能通过黑盒评估获得时的使用，并且即使梯度可获取，也可能带来显著的计算开销。 从奖励查询中估计方向提供了一种免梯度的替代方案，但有效的对齐还要求这些估计能够支持在高维噪声空间中进行稳定且高效的优化。 特别地，追求更高的奖励应当考虑生成器训练时所基于的高斯噪声输入几何结构，而以免梯度方式进行优化时这仍然具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: Here, we propose ZeNOVA , a stable and efficient gradient-free initial-noise alignment method toward black-box objectives. Specifically, as illustrated in Figure 1 , we identify the major challenges faced by existing initial noise optimization algorithms in black-box scenarios, and address them through three contributions of annealed soft-value guidance, manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics, and Metropolis-Hastings jumping. Together, these components require only forward evaluations of the generator and reward model, making ZeNOVA applicable to black-box alignment without backpropagation. Experiments on image and video generative models show that ZeNOVA achieves higher rewards than all evaluated zeroth-order baselines while maintaining more stable initial-noise optimization, supporting its practical use across diverse reward alignment tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们提出 ZeNOVA，一种面向黑盒目标的稳定且高效的无梯度初始噪声对齐方法。 具体而言，如图 1 所示，我们指出了现有初始噪声优化算法在黑盒场景中面临的主要挑战，并通过退火软值引导、流形约束的超球面朗之万动力学和 Metropolis-Hastings 跳跃这三项贡献来应对这些挑战。 这些组件共同只需要对生成器和奖励模型进行前向评估，使 ZeNOVA 无需反向传播即可适用于黑盒对齐。 在图像和视频生成模型上的实验表明，ZeNOVA 取得了比所有被评估的零阶基线更高的奖励，同时保持了更稳定的初始噪声优化，支持其在多种奖励对齐任务中的实际应用。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-Image Generation. We evaluate initial noise alignment for pretrained text-to-image generation with SDXL-turbo ( Sauer et al., 2024 ) and DMD2 ( Yin et al., 2024a ) on five tasks: ImageReward ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) , GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) , Query object counting ( Qian et al., 2025 ) , and OCR ( Cui et al., 2025 ) . The generator parameters remain fixed, and alignment is performed by updating the initial noise. ImageReward and PickScore provide differentiable preference rewards, while GenEval, Counting, and OCR evaluate compositional alignment, object counting, and text rendering through black-box reward evaluations. We additionally report aesthetic score ( Schuhmann, 2022 ) as a separate evaluation metric to assess how task-specific alignment affects visual quality. See Appendix B.3 for the detailed settings on the reward functions and utilized text prompt datasets.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows that ZeNOVA improves over uncontrolled generation, Best-of- K K , and every reported zeroth-order optimization baseline on all five task metrics for both generative models. Specifically, in black-box reward tasks, ZeNOVA achieves performance gains of + 0.046 +0.046 on GenEval and + 0.088 +0.088 on OCR from the best zeroth-order baseline, and reduces MAE of counting by around 40 % 40\% . paragraphs.en: Effect of Particle Count per Iteration. Zeroth-order methods require reward evaluations for a fixed number( N N ) of particles per iteration to estimate each method’s intended update direction of the initial noise; as N N increases, this estimate approaches the theoretical ground truth and the performance converges. In practice, since the number of available reward evaluations is finite, the performance behavior with a small number of particles becomes a critical factor in the practicality of the algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 每次迭代粒子数量的影响。 零阶方法在每次迭代中需要对固定数量（N N）的粒子进行奖励评估，以估计各方法针对初始噪声所期望的更新方向；随着 N N 增大，该估计逐渐接近理论真值，性能也随之收敛。 在实践中，由于可用的奖励评估次数是有限的，少量粒子下的性能表现成为衡量算法实用性的关键因素。

paragraphs.en: Ablation Study. We’ve conducted an ablation study on more detailed design choices of the proposed ZeNOVA in Table 3 to analyze and emphasize their role. It is shown that all three components contributed to the method’s performance and stability. paragraphs.en: We introduced ZeNOVA, a stable and efficient initial-noise optimization framework for generative models through initial-noise optimization. Guided by a reward-tilted sampling objective, ZeNOVA combines annealed soft-value guidance to extract useful signals from irregular rewards, where several crucial challenges are adequately resolved to enable stability and global exploration. Experimental results on various scenarios demonstrate that ZeNOVA consistently achieves higher rewards than the zeroth-order baselines and retains strong performance with less computational cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ZeNOVA，一个通过初始噪声优化实现生成模型优化的稳定且高效的初始噪声优化框架。 在奖励倾斜采样目标的引导下，ZeNOVA 结合退火软值引导从不规则的奖励中提取有用信号，其中若干关键挑战得到了充分解决，从而实现了稳定性与全局探索。 在多种场景下的实验结果表明，ZeNOVA 始终获得比零阶基线更高的奖励，并在更少计算成本的情况下保持强劲性能。

paragraphs.en: Reward function and text prompts. ImageReward ( Xu et al., 2024 ) and PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) return the human preference of a given image related to the text prompt. GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) evaluates the alignment between a given image and text prompt by aggregating detection result for text attributes. For counting reward, we employ an external model T2ICount ( Qian et al., 2025 ) that estimates the count of given query objects in a given image. Here, to implement a challenging black-box reward scenario, we rounded the continuous T2ICount output to a nearest whole number before used by any initial noise optimization methods. OCR reward is computed using PaddleOCR ( Cui et al., 2025 ) according to a normalized Levenshtein distance between the recognized and target text.
paragraphs.zh: 奖励函数与文本提示。 ImageReward（Xu et al., 2024）与 PickScore（Kirstain et al., 2023）返回给定图像相对于文本提示的人类偏好。 GenEval（Ghosh et al., 2023）通过汇总针对文本属性的检测结果来评估给定图像与文本提示之间的对齐程度。 对于计数奖励，我们采用外部模型 T2ICount（Qian et al., 2025）来估计给定图像中给定查询对象的数量。 在这里，为了实现一个具有挑战性的黑盒奖励场景，我们在任何初始噪声优化方法使用之前，将连续的 T2ICount 输出四舍五入到最近的整数。 OCR 奖励使用 PaddleOCR（Cui et al., 2025）根据识别文本与目标文本之间的归一化 Levenshtein 距离来计算。
